# A. Configuration & Utilities

```{r config}
# Paths
DATA_PATH <- "diabetes_012_health_indicators_BRFSS2015.csv"
OUT_DIR <- "outputs"

# Ensure Output Directories
ensure_dirs <- function() {
    dir.create(file.path(OUT_DIR, "figures"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    dir.create(file.path(OUT_DIR, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    dir.create(file.path(OUT_DIR, "metrics"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
}
ensure_dirs()

# Initialize Metrics Manifest
metrics_manifest <- list()

# Helper: Save CSV and LaTeX
save_table <- function(df, base_name, caption = NULL) {
    # CSV
    csv_path <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "tables", paste0(base_name, ".csv"))
    write.csv(df, csv_path, row.names = FALSE)

    # LaTeX
    tex_path <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "tables", paste0(base_name, ".tex"))
    # Use knitr::kable for simple reliable latex export
    # Escape special chars to avoid LaTeX errors
    # Remove caption to avoid nested table env in Latex
    tex_content <- knitr::kable(df,
        format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, longtable = FALSE,
        row.names = FALSE
    )
    writeLines(tex_content, tex_path)
}

# Helper: Save ggplot
save_ggplot <- function(p, filename, width = 10, height = 6) {
    ggsave(
        filename = file.path(OUT_DIR, "figures", filename), plot = p,
        width = width, height = height, dpi = 300
    )
}

# Helper: Save base plot
save_base_plot <- function(filename, expr, width = 10, height = 6) {
    while (dev.cur() > 1) dev.off()

    png(file.path(OUT_DIR, "figures", filename), width = width, height = height, units = "in", res = 300)
    eval(expr)
    dev.off()
}

# Helper: Macro F1
macro_f1 <- function(y_true, y_pred) {
    # Handle both factor and character inputs
    y_true <- as.factor(y_true)
    y_pred <- factor(y_pred, levels = levels(y_true))

    cm <- confusionMatrix(y_pred, y_true, mode = "everything")

    # For binary classification, caret's F1 is usually for the positive class.
    # We need Macro Average of both classes.
    if (!is.null(cm$byClass)) {
        # Check if byClass is a vector (binary) or matrix (multiclass)
        if (is.vector(cm$byClass)) {
            # Binary case: byClass contains metrics for the positive class.
            # We need to compute F1 for the negative class manually or re-run confusionMatrix?
            # Simpler: Get F1 for both classes manually from table
            tbl <- cm$table
            # F1_k = 2 * P_k * R_k / (P_k + R_k)
            # We can just use the byClass logic if we force multiclass summary,
            # but easier to manually compute from table for robustness.
            n_classes <- nrow(tbl)
            f1_scores <- numeric(n_classes)
            for (i in 1:n_classes) {
                tp <- tbl[i, i]
                fp <- sum(tbl[i, ]) - tp
                fn <- sum(tbl[, i]) - tp
                precision <- if ((tp + fp) > 0) tp / (tp + fp) else 0
                recall <- if ((tp + fn) > 0) tp / (tp + fn) else 0
                f1_scores[i] <- if ((precision + recall) > 0) 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall) else 0
            }
            return(mean(f1_scores, na.rm = TRUE))
        } else {
            # Multiclass: byClass is a matrix
            return(mean(cm$byClass[, "F1"], na.rm = TRUE))
        }
    } else {
        # Fallback
        return(NA)
    }
}

# Check existence
if (!file.exists(DATA_PATH)) {
    stop(paste("Data file not found at", DATA_PATH))
}
```

# B. Data Ingestion & Dictionary

```{r ingestion}
print("--- Loading Data ---")
df <- read.csv(DATA_PATH)

metrics_manifest$dataset_n <- nrow(df)
metrics_manifest$dataset_p <- ncol(df)

# Definitions
cols_binary <- c(
    "HighBP", "HighChol", "CholCheck", "Smoker", "Stroke", "HeartDiseaseorAttack",
    "PhysActivity", "Fruits", "Veggies", "HvyAlcoholConsump", "AnyHealthcare",
    "NoDocbcCost", "DiffWalk", "Sex"
)
cols_ordinal <- c("Age", "Education", "Income", "GenHlth")
cols_numeric <- c("BMI", "MentHlth", "PhysHlth")
target_col <- "Diabetes_012"

# Type Processing
df[cols_binary] <- lapply(df[cols_binary], factor)
df[[target_col]] <- factor(df[[target_col]])
df[cols_ordinal] <- lapply(df[cols_ordinal], as.integer)
df[cols_numeric] <- lapply(df[cols_numeric], as.numeric)
```

# C. Data Quality & Distribution Tables

```{r qc_tables}
print("--- Generating Tables ---")

# T1_target_dist: Target Distribution
target_dist <- df |>
    count(!!sym(target_col)) |>
    mutate(Proportion = n / sum(n))
save_table(target_dist, "T1_target_dist", "Target Distribution (Diabetes_012)")

metrics_manifest$target_dist <- purrr::transpose(target_dist)

# T1_cases_dist: Case Distributions
# Define Cases
df$Target_CaseA <- df[[target_col]]
df$Target_CaseB <- factor(ifelse(df[[target_col]] == 2, 1, 0)) # 2 vs {0,1}
df$Target_CaseC <- factor(ifelse(df[[target_col]] %in% c(1, 2), 1, 0)) # {1,2} vs 0

cases_info <- list(
    list(name = "CaseA", col = "Target_CaseA", desc = "{0, 1, 2}"),
    list(name = "CaseB", col = "Target_CaseB", desc = "2 vs {0, 1}"),
    list(name = "CaseC", col = "Target_CaseC", desc = "{1, 2} vs 0")
)

case_dist_list <- list()
metrics_manifest$cases <- list()

for (case in cases_info) {
    counts <- table(df[[case$col]])
    props <- prop.table(counts)
    imbalance <- round(max(counts) / min(counts), 2)

    # Add to dataframe for T1
    dist_df <- as.data.frame(counts)
    colnames(dist_df) <- c("Class", "Count")
    dist_df$Proportion <- as.numeric(props)
    dist_df$Case <- case$name
    dist_df$ImbalanceRatio <- imbalance

    case_dist_list[[case$name]] <- dist_df

    metrics_manifest$cases[[case$name]] <- list(
        counts = as.list(counts),
        proportions = as.list(props),
        imbalance_ratio = imbalance
    )
}
all_cases_dist <- do.call(rbind, case_dist_list)
save_table(all_cases_dist, "T1_cases_dist", "Case Distributions and Imbalance")

# T2_numeric_summary: Numeric Summary by Diabetes_012
num_summary <- df |>
    group_by(!!sym(target_col)) |>
    summarise(across(all_of(cols_numeric), list(mean = mean, sd = sd, median = median)))
save_table(num_summary, "T2_numeric_summary", "Numeric Summary by Target")

# T3_binary_probs: Probabilities of Key Binary Vars
# Key vars requested: HighBP, HighChol, Smoker, Stroke, HeartDiseaseorAttack, DiffWalk
key_binary_vars <- c("HighBP", "HighChol", "Smoker", "Stroke", "HeartDiseaseorAttack", "DiffWalk")
prob_list <- list()

for (v in key_binary_vars) {
    # P(Var=1 | Target=k)
    # df[[v]] is factor 0/1. Convert to numeric to get mean (prob of 1)
    prob_df <- df |>
        group_by(!!sym(target_col)) |>
        summarise(
            Variable = v,
            Prob_1 = mean(as.numeric(as.character(.data[[v]]))),
            .groups = "drop"
        )
    prob_list[[v]] <- prob_df
}
binary_probs <- do.call(rbind, prob_list)
save_table(binary_probs, "T3_binary_probs", "Probability of Condition=1 given Target")
```

# F. Statistical Tests

```{r stats}
print("--- Statistical Tests ---")

results_list <- list()
test_vars <- c(cols_binary, cols_ordinal)

cramers_v <- function(tbl) {
    chi <- chisq.test(tbl, correct = FALSE)$statistic
    n <- sum(tbl)
    k <- min(dim(tbl)) - 1
    sqrt(chi / (n * k))
}

# Chi-Square
for (var in test_vars) {
    tbl <- table(df[[var]], df[[target_col]])
    test <- chisq.test(tbl)
    cv <- cramers_v(tbl)
    results_list[[length(results_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        Variable = var, Test = "Chi-square", p_value = test$p.value,
        Effect_Size_Name = "Cramers_V", Effect_Size_Value = cv
    )
}

# Kruskal-Wallis
epsilon_squared <- function(H, n) {
    H / ((n^2 - 1) / (n + 1))
}
for (var in cols_numeric) {
    f <- as.formula(paste(var, "~", target_col))
    test <- kruskal.test(f, data = df)
    es <- epsilon_squared(test$statistic, nrow(df))
    results_list[[length(results_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        Variable = var, Test = "Kruskal-Wallis", p_value = test$p.value,
        Effect_Size_Name = "Epsilon_Sq", Effect_Size_Value = as.numeric(es)
    )
}

stats_df <- do.call(rbind, results_list)
stats_df$p_adj_fdr <- p.adjust(stats_df$p_value, method = "BH")
stats_df$p_adj_holm <- p.adjust(stats_df$p_value, method = "holm")
stats_df$Significant <- stats_df$p_adj_fdr < 0.05

# T4_stats_tests
save_table(stats_df, "T4_stats_tests", "Statistical Tests Results")

# T4_stats_top15
top15 <- stats_df |>
    arrange(desc(Effect_Size_Value)) |>
    head(15)
save_table(top15, "T4_stats_top15", "Top 15 Variables by Effect Size")
```

# F2. Permutation & Bootstrap

```{r advanced_inference}
print("--- Permutation & Bootstrap ---")

metrics_manifest$permutation <- list()
metrics_manifest$bootstrap <- list()

permutation_test_diff <- function(x, y, n_perms = 1000) {
    obs_diff <- mean(x) - mean(y)
    combined <- c(x, y)
    n_x <- length(x)
    perm_diffs <- replicate(n_perms, {
        shuffled <- sample(combined)
        mean(shuffled[1:n_x]) - mean(shuffled[(n_x + 1):length(combined)])
    })
    p_val <- mean(abs(perm_diffs) >= abs(obs_diff))
    list(obs = obs_diff, p_val = p_val, dist = perm_diffs)
}

bootstrap_ci_diff <- function(x, y, n_boot = 1000) {
    boot_diffs <- replicate(n_boot, {
        bx <- sample(x, replace = TRUE)
        by <- sample(y, replace = TRUE)
        mean(bx) - mean(by)
    })
    quantile(boot_diffs, c(0.025, 0.975))
}

# Case B data
case_b_binary <- as.numeric(as.character(df$Target_CaseB))
group_diab_bmi <- df$BMI[case_b_binary == 1]
group_non_bmi <- df$BMI[case_b_binary == 0]

# BMI Permutation
res_bmi <- permutation_test_diff(group_diab_bmi, group_non_bmi, n_perms = 1000)
save_base_plot("F6_perm_bmi_diff.png", {
    hist(res_bmi$dist, main = "Permutation Dist (BMI)", breaks = 30, col = "gray")
    abline(v = res_bmi$obs, col = "red", lwd = 2)
})
metrics_manifest$permutation$bmi_obs_diff <- res_bmi$obs
metrics_manifest$permutation$bmi_p_value <- res_bmi$p_val

# BMI Bootstrap
ci_bmi <- bootstrap_ci_diff(group_diab_bmi, group_non_bmi, n_boot = 1000)
metrics_manifest$bootstrap$bmi_ci_low <- ci_bmi[1]
metrics_manifest$bootstrap$bmi_ci_high <- ci_bmi[2]

# HighBP Permutation
group_diab_bp <- as.numeric(as.character(df$HighBP[case_b_binary == 1]))
group_non_bp <- as.numeric(as.character(df$HighBP[case_b_binary == 0]))

res_bp <- permutation_test_diff(group_diab_bp, group_non_bp, n_perms = 1000)
save_base_plot("F7_perm_highbp_diff.png", {
    hist(res_bp$dist, main = "Permutation Dist (HighBP)", breaks = 30, col = "lightblue")
    abline(v = res_bp$obs, col = "red", lwd = 2)
})
metrics_manifest$permutation$highbp_obs_diff <- res_bp$obs
metrics_manifest$permutation$highbp_p_value <- res_bp$p_val
```

# G. Modeling

```{r modeling}
print("--- Modeling ---")

feature_cols <- c(cols_numeric, cols_binary, cols_ordinal)

# Global Split - REMOVED, using case-specific split below
# set.seed(SEED)
# train_idx <- createDataPartition(df[[target_col]], p = 0.8, list = FALSE)

# Parallel
cores <- min(22, parallel::detectCores() - 1)
if (cores < 1) cores <- 1
cl <- makePSOCKcluster(cores)
registerDoParallel(cl)
print(paste("Running on", cores, "cores"))

# Setup
get_train_control <- function(strategy, seed) {
    ctrl <- trainControl(
        method = "cv",
        number = 10,
        classProbs = TRUE,
        summaryFunction = multiClassSummary,
        savePredictions = "final",
        verboseIter = FALSE,
        allowParallel = TRUE
    )
    if (strategy == "RandomOverSampler") {
        ctrl$sampling <- "up"
    } else if (strategy == "RandomUnderSampler") ctrl$sampling <- "down"
    return(ctrl)
}

run_experiment_r <- function() {
    cases <- list(CaseA = "Target_CaseA", CaseB = "Target_CaseB", CaseC = "Target_CaseC")
    models <- c("glm", "nb", "lda", "qda")
    strategies <- c("None", "ClassWeight", "RandomUnderSampler")
    results <- list()

    for (case_name in names(cases)) {
        target_var <- cases[[case_name]]
        print(paste("Processing", case_name))

        sub_df <- dplyr::select(df, dplyr::all_of(c(feature_cols, target_var)))
        colnames(sub_df)[ncol(sub_df)] <- "Class"
        levels(sub_df$Class) <- make.names(levels(sub_df$Class))

        # Split by specific case target
        set.seed(SEED)
        train_idx <- createDataPartition(sub_df$Class, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
        train_data <- sub_df[train_idx, ]

        # Metric choice
        metric_to_use <- "ROC"
        if (case_name == "CaseA") metric_to_use <- "logLoss"

        for (model in models) {
            current_model <- model
            if (model == "glm" && length(levels(train_data$Class)) > 2) current_model <- "multinom"

            for (strat in strategies) {
                if (strat == "ClassWeight" && !(current_model %in% c("glm", "multinom"))) next

                tr_ctrl <- get_train_control(strat, SEED)
                wts <- NULL
                if (strat == "ClassWeight") {
                    tab <- table(train_data$Class)
                    wts <- (1 / tab)[train_data$Class]
                }

                tryCatch(
                    {
                        set.seed(SEED)
                        fit <- train(Class ~ .,
                            data = train_data, method = current_model,
                            trControl = tr_ctrl, weights = wts, metric = metric_to_use,
                            tuneLength = 3, trace = FALSE
                        )

                        # Custom CV Macro F1 Calculation
                        # fit$pred contains predictions from hold-out folds in CV
                        # Group by Resample, calc Macro F1, then mean
                        cv_preds <- fit$pred
                        if (!is.null(cv_preds)) {
                            f1_folds <- cv_preds |>
                                group_by(Resample) |>
                                summarise(MacroF1 = macro_f1(obs, pred)) |>
                                summarise(MeanMacroF1 = mean(MacroF1, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
                                pull(MeanMacroF1)
                            f1_score <- f1_folds
                        } else {
                            # Fallback if no predictions saved
                            # best_res <- fit$results[as.numeric(row.names(fit$bestTune)), ]
                            best_res <- dplyr::semi_join(fit$results, fit$bestTune, by = names(fit$bestTune))
                            f1_score <- if ("Mean_F1" %in% names(best_res)) best_res$Mean_F1 else NA
                        }

                        # best_res <- fit$results[as.numeric(row.names(fit$bestTune)), ]
                        best_res <- dplyr::semi_join(fit$results, fit$bestTune, by = names(fit$bestTune))
                        bal_acc <- if ("Balanced_Accuracy" %in% names(best_res)) best_res$Balanced_Accuracy else NA
                        auc_val <- if ("ROC" %in% names(best_res)) best_res$ROC else NA

                        results[[length(results) + 1]] <- data.frame(
                            Case = case_name, Model = current_model, Strategy = strat,
                            CV_F1 = f1_score, CV_BalAcc = bal_acc, CV_AUC = auc_val
                        )
                    },
                    error = function(e) {
                        print(paste("Failed:", case_name, current_model, strat))
                    }
                )
            }
        }
    }
    if (length(results) == 0) {
        return(data.frame())
    }
    return(dplyr::bind_rows(results))
}

results_df <- run_experiment_r()
# Don't stop cluster yet, need it for best model retraining

save_table(results_df, "T5_model_grid", "Model Grid Search Results")
```

# G7. Best Model Evaluation & Artifacts

```{r evaluation}
print("--- Best Models & Artifacts ---")

metrics_manifest$best_per_case <- list()
best_overall_metric <- -1
best_overall_info <- NULL

if (nrow(results_df) > 0) {
    cases_list <- unique(results_df$Case)
    best_models_df <- list()

    for (c in cases_list) {
        # Pick best by CV_F1
        best_row <- results_df |>
            filter(Case == c) |>
            arrange(desc(CV_F1)) |>
            slice(1)

        # Retrain
        case_col <- ifelse(c == "CaseA", "Target_CaseA", ifelse(c == "CaseB", "Target_CaseB", "Target_CaseC"))
        sub_df <- df |> select(all_of(c(feature_cols, case_col)))
        colnames(sub_df)[ncol(sub_df)] <- "Class"
        levels(sub_df$Class) <- make.names(levels(sub_df$Class))

        # Re-split by specific case target (same seed)
        set.seed(SEED)
        train_idx <- createDataPartition(sub_df$Class, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)

        train_data <- sub_df[train_idx, ]
        test_data <- sub_df[-train_idx, ]

        ctrl <- get_train_control(best_row$Strategy, SEED)
        wts <- NULL
        if (best_row$Strategy == "ClassWeight") {
            tab <- table(train_data$Class)
            wts <- (1 / tab)[train_data$Class]
        }

        set.seed(SEED)
        final_fit <- train(Class ~ .,
            data = train_data, method = best_row$Model,
            trControl = ctrl, weights = wts, tuneLength = 3, trace = FALSE
        )

        # Predict & Test Metric
        preds <- predict(final_fit, test_data)
        test_macro_f1 <- macro_f1(test_data$Class, preds)

        # Store for T5_best_models
        best_row$Test_F1 <- test_macro_f1
        best_models_df[[c]] <- best_row

        metrics_manifest$best_per_case[[c]] <- list(
            model = best_row$Model,
            strategy = best_row$Strategy,
            cv_f1 = best_row$CV_F1,
            test_macro_f1 = test_macro_f1
        )

        # Track Global Best (by Test Macro F1)
        if (!is.na(test_macro_f1) && test_macro_f1 > best_overall_metric) {
            best_overall_metric <- test_macro_f1
            best_overall_info <- list(
                case = c,
                model = final_fit,
                row = best_row,
                test_data = test_data,
                preds = preds
            )
        }
    }

    best_summary <- do.call(rbind, best_models_df)
    save_table(best_summary, "T5_best_models", "Best Models Per Case")
} else {
    stop("No models trained successfully.")
}

stopCluster(cl)
```

```{r global_best}
print("--- Generating Global Best Artifacts ---")

if (!is.null(best_overall_info)) {
    bo <- best_overall_info

    # Metrics Manifest Update
    metrics_manifest$best_overall <- list(
        case_name = bo$case,
        model = bo$row$Model,
        strategy = bo$row$Strategy,
        test_macro_f1 = best_overall_metric
    )

    # F8: Confusion Matrix
    cm <- confusionMatrix(bo$preds, bo$test_data$Class)
    cm_table <- as.data.frame(cm$table)
    # ggplot heatmap
    p8 <- ggplot(cm_table, aes(x = Reference, y = Prediction, fill = Freq)) +
        geom_tile() +
        geom_text(aes(label = Freq), color = "white") +
        scale_fill_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red") +
        labs(title = paste("Confusion Matrix -", bo$case, "(", bo$row$Model, ")")) +
        theme_minimal()
    save_ggplot(p8, "F8_confusion_bestcase.png")

    metrics_manifest$confusion_matrix_bestcase <- as.data.frame(cm$table)

    # F9: ROC (if binary)
    if (length(levels(bo$test_data$Class)) == 2) {
        probs <- predict(bo$model, bo$test_data, type = "prob")
        # Assume second level is positive "X1" or similar
        pos_class <- levels(bo$test_data$Class)[2]
        roc_obj <- roc(bo$test_data$Class, probs[[pos_class]], levels = levels(bo$test_data$Class))

        save_base_plot("F9_roc_bestcase.png", {
            plot(roc_obj, main = paste("ROC Curve -", bo$case))
        })
        metrics_manifest$roc_auc_bestcase <- auc(roc_obj)
    }

    # T6: Coefficients (if GLM/Multinom)
    if (bo$row$Model %in% c("glm", "multinom")) {
        imp <- varImp(bo$model, scale = FALSE)
        # varImp for caret glm returns statistic, not coef directly usually.
        # Better to get coefficients from finalModel
        if (bo$row$Model == "glm") {
            coefs <- coef(bo$model$finalModel)
            # Convert to DF
            coef_df <- data.frame(Feature = names(coefs), Coefficient = coefs)
            coef_df$OR <- exp(coef_df$Coefficient)
            coef_df <- coef_df |>
                arrange(desc(abs(Coefficient))) |>
                head(15)
            save_table(coef_df, "T6_coeff_or", "Top 15 Coefficients & Odds Ratios")

            metrics_manifest$top_features <- coef_df
        } else {
            # Multinom
            # coefs are matrix
            coefs <- coef(bo$model$finalModel)
            # Just save raw dump or skipped for complexity in instruction
            # Instruction says "only if best overall is Logistic/GLM"
        }
    }

    # Bootstrapping CI for Best Model Test Macro F1
    # This matches "boot_ci_low", "boot_ci_high" requirement
    test_y <- bo$test_data$Class
    pred_y <- bo$preds

    boot_f1s <- replicate(1000, {
        idx <- sample(length(test_y), replace = TRUE)
        t_boot <- test_y[idx]
        p_boot <- pred_y[idx]
        # Avoid errors if only 1 class sampled
        if (length(unique(t_boot)) < 2) {
            return(NA)
        }
        macro_f1(t_boot, p_boot)
    })
    boot_f1s <- na.omit(boot_f1s)
    ci <- quantile(boot_f1s, c(0.025, 0.975))

    metrics_manifest$best_overall$boot_ci_low <- ci[1]
    metrics_manifest$best_overall$boot_ci_high <- ci[2]
}

# Final JSON Export
write_json(metrics_manifest, file.path(OUT_DIR, "metrics", "metrics_manifest.json"),
    auto_unbox = TRUE, pretty = TRUE
)

print("--- Pipeline Complete. Artifacts in outputs/ ---")
```
